description: DESTRUCTIVE, cvrt-lang 0.10.0+: remove the old language plugin's data that lang_migrate_cleanup_plan listed (POST /migrate/{source}/cleanup, body exactly { confirm }). Refused before any request unless the site is a Bearfort fort and backup_job_id is a backup job of THIS fort that completed less than 60 minutes ago (needs BEARFORT_API_KEY). Order: fort_backup_create -> fort_job_get until completed -> lang_migrate_cleanup_plan (fresh 30-minute token) -> this tool. The server also writes a verified dump of every removed row to its own backup directory before removing anything; the answer names the dump's file name, bytes, sha256 and rows (never a path). A failure after the dump answers 500 with `dropped` and the dump. Rollback is the fort backup.

backup_job_id.description: jobId of a fort_backup_create of this site that completed less than 60 minutes ago

confirm.description: The `confirm` token of lang_migrate_cleanup_plan (valid 30 minutes, bound to that plan)

source.description: Import source: wpml or polylang (the plugin the site is moving away from)

name: lang_migrate_cleanup_apply
